profile.title: Dancing With Systems
profile.canonical_definition: Donella Meadows's practical disciplines for acting with feedback-rich and partly unpredictable systems: observe, listen, expose assumptions, learn, protect information and work for the good of the whole.
profile.summary: Dancing With Systems presents practical disciplines for acting with systems whose behaviour cannot be fully predicted or controlled.
profile.why_it_matters: It connects systems knowledge to conduct: observation, humility, learning, information integrity, responsibility, time horizons and care for the whole.
open_checks: connect each discipline to practice cases
